_label: 031 -- 030 with the three defects its own render showed. (a) A parting opened along the crown midline, so the gravity drop is now shielded on the crown, where real hair is shortest and lies on the skull. (b) The sides hung past the jaw to the neck, so they are shortened and the stray clamp tightened until it binds. (c) The forehead was bare with a ruled hairline arc, and the reference has a fringe sweeping across the brow, so the fringe is lengthened, pulled forward, and recruited from further back on the top where the mass actually is.
_forced_change_1: frame_up/frame_fwd/length_unit -- the hero authoring blend is Z-up in centimetres where the pack groom is Y-up in metres.
_forced_change_2: clump_index_block 60 -> 0. index_probe on the hero groom reads ratio 1.0026 at stride 1 against the pack groom's 0.0331: consecutive-index roots here are exactly as far apart as random pairs, because author_hero_hair.py samples roots by AREA WEIGHT and emits no authored patch order. An index block would therefore lock 60 strands scattered across the whole scalp into one clump, which is not a clump -- it is a net. The lat/long partition has to carry the texture instead.
